privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page describes how the Hafo Travel website currently works and the choices available when you contact us.

sections.title: Information in the form
paragraphs: The form contains your name, email and message. It currently validates information on your device and does not send it through a contact API. The form directs you to phone or email instead.

sections.title: When you contact us directly
paragraphs: When you call or email, you choose to share information through that channel to discuss a journey. Share only what is needed for your enquiry; do not enter passwords, identity documents or payment details in this form.

sections.title: Preferences on your device
paragraphs: The website uses a language preference and stores the notice choice in your browser. You can remove these using your browser site-data settings. The public website currently has no analytics or advertising integration.

sections.title: Links and photographs
paragraphs: Phone and email links open the corresponding applications on your device. Photographs are served by this website, with sources and usage information recorded in the project documentation.

sections.title: Questions and updates
paragraphs: For questions about information you have shared directly, contact haodev1307@gmail.com or 0947055644. This page will be updated when the website adds services or changes how information is handled.

terms.title: Website terms
terms.intro: The information below explains the scope of the content and current features of the Hafo Travel website.

sections.title: Travel inspiration
paragraphs: Journeys, itineraries and experiences on this website are inspiration. They do not confirm a booking, ticket, room or scheduled departure.

sections.title: Prices and specific services
paragraphs: The website does not publish an official price list or departure calendar. Stays, transport, activities, budget and related conditions must be discussed and confirmed separately before you decide.

sections.title: Photographs and places
paragraphs: Photographs introduce places and provide inspiration. Images of resorts, cruises or service venues do not by themselves confirm a partnership with Hafo Travel or a reservation at that venue.

sections.title: Contact channels
paragraphs: You can call 0947055644 or email haodev1307@gmail.com. The website form cannot send messages yet, and online booking and payment are not available.

sections.title: Using the content
paragraphs: Please respect the usage rights of the photographs, identity assets and content presented here. Image sources are recorded with the project for management and replacement.

sections.title: Changes and questions
paragraphs: Website content may be updated as information becomes available. Contact Hafo Travel directly if you need to clarify a journey or information about using the website.

headline: Ha Giang, beyond the mountain roads
about: A journey for those who want to see another side of Vietnam. Winding roads reveal deep valleys, small homes and the open skies of the limestone plateau.
Make time for Dong Van, a boat ride on the Nho Que River and unhurried stops along the way. This is an itinerary idea; the route and duration are discussed before travel.
